items.name: prism-async-button
items.title: Prism Async button
items.description: Async button and its shared Prism hooks, copied as editable source.
items.docs: Requires React 18+ and Tailwind CSS 4. Styled for a dark surface. Imports live under your configured UI alias at prism/components; shared hooks stay beside them. AI response includes a stream adapter hook, not an AI provider or credentials. See https://prism.sammii.dev/docs/installation for usage and boundaries.
